notes: "Sohom Estate" appears to be a misspelling of Soham Estates: the Kolkata real-estate developer Soham Group uses the domain sohamestates.com (page titles "Soham Group"), and lists Pravya (5 towers, B+G+13, 3 & 4 BHK, Jogardanga More, Rajarhat) as its ongoing project. No business literally named "Sohom Estate" was found. Not to be confused with sohamgroup.in (an unrelated logistics/minerals firm) or sohamgroup.co (Pune). DTC Group lists Pravya as "Soham & DTC Group" at dtcgroup.in/pravya-rajarhat/. Images are the full-resolution originals from the site gallery (served via the site API host api.sohamestates.com/uploads/); files are large (1-3 MB, up to 5000 px wide). Facebook: facebook.com/SohamGroupKolkata.
